Physics verifier notes: MuJoCo failed: screw_access, fit_penetration, min_clearance, load_hold, seated_displacement

How the MuJoCo test rig works (fix the geometry so it passes): the part is screwed flat onto a door plate by M4 screws (Ø4.0 shank, Ø7 head) through VERTICAL through-holes in the base; every hole must be reachable from straight above (no part geometry over any hole). The rig finds the latch channel as a horizontal pocket running across the full part width (Y) with material directly above AND below it, puts a Ø6 mm striker pin in it, and pulls it with 20 N; the part must not move more than 0.5 mm and the striker must stay captured. So: make a clear horizontal channel of inner diameter >= 6.6 mm (>= 0.3 mm clearance) spanning the full width with no ribs, gussets or fillets intruding into it; a hook lip that wraps over the top of the channel and comes back down past the striker's centre so it cannot slide out; put the screw holes close to the hook on both sides of the load, base >= 3 mm thick; keep all fillets/gussets outside the channel and away from the holes.
